_comment: Cobalt 2.0 egg — pairs with ghcr.io/whispers88/cobalt-egg:latest (v2 image)
name: Cobalt88 v2
author: whispers88dev@gmail.com
description: Rust Dedicated Server — Cobalt 2.0: version pin/rollback, wipe management, logfile+WebRCON console. Console: .help for commands.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Query port (UDP). Must differ from game port.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: WebRCON port (TCP).

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Rust+ App port (TCP). Use -1 to disable.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Use \n for new lines.

variables.name: URL
variables.description: Appears on "Visit Website".

variables.name: Server Image
variables.description: Header image URL.

variables.name: Server Logo
variables.description: Circular logo (Rust+).

variables.name: Level
variables.description: World file (e.g., Procedural Map).

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: For procedural maps.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: For procedural maps. Overridden after wipes when Wipe New Seed is set.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum concurrent players.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Set a strong password. The console send-path depends on it.

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Auto-save interval in seconds.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Direct download URL overrides the map. Invalid URLs crash the server.

variables.name: Server Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated tags (e.g. monthly,vanilla,NA). See Facepunch docs.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Rust gamemode.

variables.name: Server Identity
variables.description: Folder for saves/logs (server/<identity>). Wipes target this folder.

variables.name: Rust+ Public IP
variables.description: Node public IP if needed (usually auto).

variables.name: Modding Framework
variables.description: vanilla, oxide, oxide-staging, carbon, carbon-minimal, carbon-edge, carbon-edge-minimal, carbon-staging, carbon-staging-minimal, carbon-aux1, carbon-aux1-minimal, carbon-aux2, carbon-aux2-minimal

variables.name: Auto Update Game
variables.description: Run SteamCMD app_update on start (1=yes, 0=no). Ignored while pinned.

variables.name: Framework Update
variables.description: Update/install the selected framework on start (1=yes, 0=no). Ignored while pinned.

variables.name: Validate Game Files
variables.description: Full SteamCMD file validation each start (slow — minutes). Normally 0; runs automatically once after a rollback.

variables.name: Pin Build
variables.description: Freeze the server on this Steam buildid (empty = not pinned). Console: .pin / .unpin / .version.

variables.name: Wipe New Seed
variables.description: Seed handling after a wipe: keep, random, or a comma-separated rotation list.

variables.name: Wipe Map URL(s)
variables.description: Custom map applied on wipe. A single URL, or a comma-separated list rotated one per wipe. Empty = keep the configured map (procedural or Custom Map URL). Overrides Custom Map URL when set.

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout (sec)
variables.description: How long to wait for the save on quit before force-killing. Big maps need 30-60s.

variables.name: Update Check Interval (sec)
variables.description: Warn in console when Facepunch ships a new build. 0 = disabled.

variables.name: Telemetry Interval (sec)
variables.description: Periodic game CPU/RSS line in console. 0 = disabled (.telemetry works regardless).

variables.name: Allow Stdin Escape Hatch
variables.description: Enable the .stdin command (writes directly to game stdin). Rarely needed.

variables.name: Preserve Dirs
variables.description: Comma-separated top-level names a rollback apply must never touch.

variables.name: Min Free Disk (MB)
variables.description: Refuse to boot below this much free disk (DISK_ENFORCE=1).

variables.name: Enforce Disk Guard
variables.description: 1 = refuse to boot on low disk, 0 = warn only.

variables.name: Preflight Port Check
variables.description: Check RCON/query/game ports are free before boot.

variables.name: OOM Watch
variables.description: Warn at boot if the previous run was OOM-killed.

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Optional Steam branch (e.g., staging, aux1). Auto-set by staging/aux frameworks.

variables.name: Steam Branch Password
variables.description: Password for private Steam branch (if any).

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra RustDedicated startup flags.
